basis: tuning split only (seed 48001, 6289 sessions); labels at the exact Stop where each config fires; best Wilson 95 percent lower bound among configs with at least 20 tuning nudges

signals.denial_v2: errored results matching was denied, permission to use, user doesn't want to proceed, hook error, <tool_use_error>blocked, or requires approval (case-insensitive); rejected removed
signals.stop_feedback: user records starting with 'Stop hook feedback:'
signals.error_streak_max: longest run of consecutive errored tool results
